item.text: [{"task_id":"ba9d41b8","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['pattern'][0]))","    margin = int(round(params['pattern'][1]))","    period = int(round(params['pattern'][2]))","    phase = int(round(params['pattern'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if period <= 0:","        return out","    height, width = grid.shape","    seen = set()","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            if grid[row, col] == background or (row, col) in seen:","                continue","            color = grid[row, col]","            cells = [(row, col)]","            seen.add((row, col))","            for r, c in cells:","                for direction in params['neighbors']:","                    nr = r + int(round(direction[0]))","                    nc = c + int(round(direction[1]))","                    if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:","                        if (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr, nc] == color:","                            seen.add((nr, nc))","                            cells.append((nr, nc))","            top = min(r for r, c in cells)","            bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)","            left = min(c for r, c in cells)","            right = max(c for r, c in cells)","            for r, c in cells:","                if top + margin <= r <= bottom - margin and left + margin <= c <= right - margin:","                    if ((r - top) + (c - left)) % period == phase:","                        out[r, c] = background","    return out"],"shapes":{"pattern":[4],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"pattern":[0,1,2,0],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Preserve each rectangle's one-cell border and erase alternating interior cells, starting with the upper-left interior cell. The tensors encode background, border thickness, checkerboard period and phase, and component connectivity."}]
